content:
Starting today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs via the Messages app using text or voice commands. Details are as follows.

Suno brings song generation to iMessage

Suno is currently one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paying subscribers and 7 million songs generated daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app that allows users to create and remix AI-generated songs using text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The app also features collections of user-created songs, curated edits, and playlists organised by genre.

Now, Suno users can create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. After installing the Suno app, it will appear alongside other iMessage apps in the app drawer within Messages, allowing users to generate songs via text prompts or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a demonstration of the feature in action:

Suno says users can select a genre before generating a song, regenerate to try different versions, and then choose which version to send in the conversation.

One potential limitation is that Suno says both users need to have the app installed to use this feature. However, for fans of AI song creation, downloading the free app shouldn't be an issue.

Download Suno from the App Store.
